sections.label: Overview
sections.title: Tadalafil repurposing research
sections.paragraph: This profile is a starting point for tadalafil repurposing questions. No tadalafil-specific findings have been mapped to this page. Its inclusion in the drug directory does not establish benefit for any condition.

sections.label: Status
sections.title: What is available here
sections.paragraph: A tadalafil-specific assessment of original reports, benefits, mechanisms, safety and interactions is not yet available in this library. This page does not conclude that relevant studies are absent from the wider literature.

sections.label: Connections

faqs.question: Does this page establish that tadalafil works for a repurposed use?
faqs.answer: No. This profile has no mapped tadalafil-specific findings and provides no efficacy verdict. A useful answer requires the exact condition, population, comparison and outcome, with supporting original reports.

faqs.question: Can I use the sildenafil page as evidence for tadalafil?
faqs.answer: The sildenafil profile is a separate research entry. This library has not established that a finding about sildenafil applies to tadalafil.

faqs.question: Does this profile provide safety or dosing guidance?
faqs.answer: No. A tadalafil-specific safety, interaction and exposure assessment has not been completed for this page.

title: Aging & longevity
description: Explore questions about longevity, physical function and aging. Evidence coverage is incomplete.
scope: A research goal spanning aging and longevity, not a disease diagnosis or an additional clinical condition.

sections.label: Overview
sections.title: Questions about aging and longevity
sections.paragraph: This hub brings together questions about longevity and aging-related outcomes. Aging is presented here as a research goal, not a disease diagnosis. The library includes reader questions about sirolimus, longevity, ovarian preservation and exercise-related concerns; those questions do not establish clinical benefit.

sections.label: Options
sections.title: Where to begin
sections.paragraph: The sirolimus profile contains the library’s longevity and ovarian-preservation questions. The metformin and sarcopenia pages provide a separate route into physical-function research. These are distinct reading paths; findings about one outcome should not be presented as an answer about another.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.title: Evidence coverage
sections.paragraph: An integrated assessment of lifespan, physical function and other aging-related outcomes is not yet available on this page. No efficacy ranking or treatment recommendation follows from these reading links.

sections.label: Connections
sections.title: Continue reading
sections.paragraph: Follow the linked profiles for their specific questions, findings and limitations.

faqs.question: What does this page mean by aging and longevity?
faqs.answer: This hub groups reader questions about lifespan and aging-related outcomes. It treats aging as a research goal rather than a disease diagnosis, and keeps individual outcomes separate.

faqs.question: Which questions can I explore next?
faqs.answer: Open the sirolimus profile for longevity and ovarian-preservation questions, or the metformin and sarcopenia pages for the library’s physical-function research. Each entry has its own evidence scope and limitations.

faqs.question: Does this hub identify a drug proven to extend human life?
faqs.answer: No. This page does not provide a lifespan-benefit conclusion or rank drugs by effectiveness.
